component.name: Doska
component.summary: Offline-first kanban board with Markdown cards

description.p: Doska is a kanban board that is quick, Markdown-first, minimal, and still feature-rich.
Boards are stored locally first and sync shortly after every change to a folder on disk or to your own server.

ul.li: Offline-first: the board works with no network at all
Markdown editor with syntax highlighting, tasks and a slash menu
Two way folder sync, boards as folders and cards as Markdown files
Self-hosted sync server for boards across devices
Members, shared boards and public boards
Deadlines, priorities and a deadline view across every board
Quick note window, always on top, opened with a global shortcut
